Wagner Logistics to Add Nearly 80 Jobs with New High-Volume Logistics Operation in Liberty

# Wagner Logistics to Add Nearly 80 Jobs with New High-Volume Logistics Operation in Liberty

 Wagner Logistics 

Oct 14, 2026, 08:54 ET

NORTH KANSAS CITY, Mo., Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Wagner Logistics, a nationwide provider of third-party logistics, today announced it has signed a multi-year agreement with a Kansas City-area manufacturer to launch a new manufacturing support and warehouse operations program in Liberty, Mo.

The new operation includes two leased warehouse facilities in the Liberty area totaling more than 830,000 square feet. Wagner expects to add 79 new local jobs over the next two years, starting immediately. The company will also make a multi-million-dollar investment in equipment, infrastructure and automated trailer loading and unloading technology to support the operation.

"This is exactly the kind of operation where Wagner's strengths come through," said Brian Smith, President and Chief Executive Officer of Wagner Logistics. "It requires speed, flexibility, close coordination and the ability to design a solution around what the customer actually needs."

# A. Duie Pyle Opens 78,760-SF Warehouse in Camp Hill, Pennsylvania

 October 6, 2026 

 

A. Duie Pyle has opened a 78,760-square-foot warehouse in Camp Hill, Pennsylvania, creating an integrated logistics center that combines warehousing with the company’s existing less-than-truckload operations on one campus.

The new warehouse, located at 485 Terminal St., sits directly adjacent to Pyle’s LTL service center at 475 Terminal St. By connecting the two operations, the West Chester, Pennsylvania-based logistics company is bringing inventory storage and regional transportation into a single facility designed to reduce freight handoffs and accelerate distribution.

The Camp Hill hub connects customers with Pyle’s transportation network across the Northeast, Mid-Atlantic and Ohio while providing warehouse capacity close to several major regional freight corridors.

The facility has convenient access to Interstate 81, Interstate 76, Interstate 83 and U.S. Route 15, positioning inventory within reach of major population and distribution markets throughout Central Pennsylvania and the surrounding region.

# Davidson Logistics opens new warehouse in Bridgeton 

Davidson Logistics celebrated the grand opening of its new warehouse in Bridgeton on Thursday.

By First Alert 4 Staff

Published: Oct. 8, 2026 at 6:44 PM CDT

BRIDGETON, Mo. (First Alert 4) - Davidson Logistics celebrated the grand opening of its new warehouse in Bridgeton on Thursday.

The opening marks the latest step in the company’s expansion, which began more than 40 years ago. Davidson provides delivery and inventory services to major companies, including General Electric and Boeing.

The new warehouse is part of the company’s broader expansion plans. Its president says future contracts with Boeing could allow Davidson to hire as many as 200 workers.

October 7, 2026• 3 min read

Dermody announced two new leases totaling 376,503 square feet at The Logistics Campus in Glenview, Illinois, a Class A logistics development just north of O'Hare International Airport. S&C Electric Company fully leased Building 5, a 295,278-square-foot facility, and LSL Industries, LLC leased 81,225 square feet of Building 4, the firm announced on Oct. 6.

Colliers represented Dermody in both transactions. Cushman & Wakefield represented S&C Electric Company, and CBRE represented LSL Industries.

## Lease Details at The Logistics Campus

The Logistics Campus is located at 3075 Sanders Road in Glenview. The two leases cover 100% of Building 5 and approximately half of Building 4, which totals 162,553 square feet and is located at 2551 Protection Parkway.
